units.source_text: 云林院离贺茂神社甚近，源氏大将便寄信与当斋院的槿姬。

en.t: Unrin-in was very near Kamo Shrine, so General Genji sent a letter to Princess Asagao, who was then serving as Kamo Saiin.

units.source_text: 信是向槿姬的侍女中将君诉恨的：

en.t: The letter poured out his grievances to Princess Asagao's attendant, Chujo no Kimi:
Now I am staying as a traveler in a lonely temple, gazing sadly up at the wide sky,

units.source_text: 渴慕故人，不知能蒙斋院俯察下情否？”

en.t: longing deeply for an old friend; I wonder whether the Saiin might kindly understand my feelings?
He also sent the Saiin a poem:
